entities.name: Won Tae-in

entities.summary: Won Tae-in is a South Korean professional baseball pitcher currently playing for the Samsung Lions of the KBO League. He competed in the 2020 Summer Olympics, the 2022 Asian Games, and the 2023 World Baseball Classic.
